crop.notes: A 'PERSONAL' column of unrelated telegraph items (Schenck, Sheridan, Dake, Pullman party, Chase); only the last item, 'TOM. ALLEN, P.R.', is about Allen.

ocr.notes: Most of the column is readable, but the Allen heading and first line are garbled ('anaes Bete antagmit', 'MeCoole's 'om.').

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a Cincinnati dispatch of June 6 reporting that Tom Allen, McCoole's antagonist, had given a sparring exhibition there the night before.

metadata.notes: The page head reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, June 7, 1869'. The St. Louis Republic name dates from 1888.

facts.fact: Allen gave a sparring exhibition in Cincinnati

notes: The Allen item is a two-line telegram; focus is primary for the item though it is a small part of the clipping.
